summary: Tested assignment-aware KPI access control and completion tracking. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests passed covering /api/esg-assignments/kpi-access/ghg, /kpi-access/facilities, /kpi-access/facilities/list, /assignments/{id}/progress, and admin bypass on /api/emissions, /api/sinks. Frontend: verified admin sees all Scope 1/2/3/Biogenic tabs on Emissions page, and no sinks access warning banner appears for admin on Sinks page. No blocking issues found for this feature.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: <span data-ve-dynamic> wrapper placed as direct child of <tbody>, causing 'span cannot be a child of tbody' warnings. Unrelated to this feature but worth cleaning up.
Pre-existing Recharts warnings: 'A props object containing a key prop is being spread into JSX' (Area/Bar). Not a functional bug but should be fixed.

action_items: Feature works correctly for admin users - full access confirmed on all KPI access endpoints.

Non-admin restricted scenarios not exhaustively tested because no non-admin credentials with GHG assignments were seeded; default-open path (no assignments -> has_full_access) validated via admin fixture. Main agent may want to seed a non-admin user + a facility-level GHG assignment for negative-path regression.
critical_code_review_comments: kpi_access_helper.get_allowed_facilities builds a query with both 'category' key deletion and '$and' reassignment - the current logic works but is convoluted; consider refactoring to a single build path.
In kpi_access_helper.is_admin, roles list includes 'admin', 'super_admin', 'org_admin' - ensure this matches all admin roles defined in the auth module; confirmed 'admin' matches test user.

completion_tracking._check_facility_has_data uses regex on reporting_period for yearly matching; ensure indices exist on (organization_id, facility_id, reporting_period) in emission_records to keep this performant.
Router imports (from .kpi_access_helper import kpi_access_helper) are inside each endpoint function - fine, but could be hoisted to module level for consistency and minor perf.
seed_data_creation: None. Existing ORG1 data (7 facilities, 289 emission records, 7 sink records) was sufficient.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints /api/esg-assignments/kpi-access/{ghg,facilities,facilities/list} and /api/esg-assignments/assignments/{id}/progress are live and return admin full-access correctly. Emissions/Sinks GET endpoints work with KPI access filtering (admin bypass verified). Non-admin restricted flows (403 on POST /api/emissions or /api/sinks when scope/facility not assigned) were NOT tested end-to-end because no non-admin user with restrictive GHG assignments exists in the DB - main agent should seed if needed. Frontend hooks useGHGAccess and useFacilityAccess integrated in Emissions.js and Sinks.js load and render successfully for admin.
